stories.title: Braves Eliminate Phillies 6-2 in Game 3 — Advance to NLDS vs. Dodgers

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Atlanta ended Philly's season with three home runs. Harris II (3-run, 1st inning), Albies (2-run, 4th), Olson (solo, 8th). Braves 6, Phillies 2. The winner-take-all curse is over. #Braves face the Dodgers on Saturday. #MLB

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Braves snap a 6-game losing streak in winner-take-all games — and do it emphatically. Michael Harris II greeted Aaron Nola with a 3-run blast in the 1st inning. Atlanta advances to the NLDS. #Braves #MLB

x_posts.label: Post 5-1
x_posts.text: First-ever postseason meeting: Padres vs. Brewers. Milwaukee went 103-59, best record in baseball, fully rested. San Diego just swept the Cubs. Someone is getting upset Saturday. #Padres #Brewers #NLDS

x_posts.label: Post 5-2
x_posts.text: Brewers are heavy favorites in the NLDS — but the Padres won the regular-season series 4-2 and have Tatis Jr., Machado, and Mason Miller in that lineup. Don't sleep on San Diego. #NLDS #MLB
